verdict.rationale: Unleash's pricing page lists a first-party "Export/import feature flags for easy migration" feature, so the product itself ships a migration-oriented export. That export covers only feature flags, not all data, and the evidence never names the file format. The Admin API's claimed full programmatic access is a developer building block for building an export, not an export feature, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: export coverage of all data (users, projects, segments, environments, audit history), documentation that the export uses an open format such as JSON, in-depth export/migration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
